name: Analucia / Sofia
title: A personal diamond expert for Analucia.
summary: AI Catalyst brought together specialist partners to put Sofia, an AI jewellery expert, inside Analucia’s online shopping experience.
thumbnailAlt: Sofia’s jewellery guidance interface in the Analucia shopping experience

sections.heading: The challenge
sections.body: Bring expert product guidance into online jewellery shopping, where customers need help comparing pieces and choosing what suits them.

sections.heading: What shipped
sections.body: A digital host integrated into the shopping experience, giving customers a way to ask product questions while exploring the jewellery.

sections.heading: What shoppers can do
sections.body: Ask about pieces, explore matching jewellery and get guidance towards a purchase. The film shows the experience in action.
